standard_prerequisites.name: For a bounded above complex of finite free modules the systems of cohomology of the reductions modulo I^n satisfy Mittag-Leffler and the I-adic completion of the cohomology equals the limit of the cohomologies of the reductions

core_obligations: Represent K by a bounded above complex P of finite free A-modules; then K_n is represented by P/I^n P (proof lines 29006-29009). The images of the transition maps on cohomology are controlled by the submodule inclusions I^n H^i(P) inside the finite modules H^i(P), so the systems H^i(K_n) satisfy Mittag-Leffler by the consequence-Artin-Rees lemma (proof lines 29009-29010). The kollar-kovacs lemma identifies the I-adic completion of H^i(K) with lim H^i(K_n) for such systems, giving the final statement (proof lines 29010-29011).
proof_roadmap: Represent K by a finite free complex and describe the reductions (proof lines 29006-29009).
Get the Mittag-Leffler property from Artin-Rees and the limit identification (proof lines 29009-29011).
